payload.text: **0088 row 2 AMENDED: empty input for tools run from a COMMAND LINE only (config run:, catalogue command lines); devbin's own in-process functions keep stdin** (hv, 2026-09-18, option (a)). Decision 14 rested on vc's census claim that no gate reads input; it missed devbin's own @builtin gates -- clean asks before removing, reading /dev/tty only when stdin is a tty -- and the full suite caught it (clean.bats 106, 114). vc builds, checking the remaining built-in functions for input reads with a floor that finds clean's; dc reviews.
